answer: Each identity files work at one jetty intake, paying an 80-credit bond plus a 20-credit fee: 100 credits for one identity, 100,000 for 1,000 fakes. Credit needs an echo check: two verifiers contact the client, and the client echo must match the filing, or the bond burns and the identity freezes. All echo results go in a meadow ledger, and one client may echo for at most three identities per epoch, so the kth fake needs a fresh client and 100 credits. Renting one client fails: the meadow record shows the repeated voice and the cap blocks a fourth echo. An honest agent pays 100 once.
